title: MC: Triboss Mayhem
description: A Modpack offering a semi-short adventure and fighting experience
body:
![Pack Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9c90c41cb15d70aca1e3a9ea36c476ff6d02dda.png)

---
### Overview:
MC: Triboss Mayhem is a modpack designed to provide a fast-paced yet challenging survival or hardcore experience. Players must battle three unique bosses and complete a series of custom advancements to achieve victory.

---
### Features:
A relatively fast pace is recommended as you slip in and out of dimensions to avoid the approaching Wither Storm (neatly hinted at through advancements). Alongside your escape efforts, you’ll gear up to eventually take on the Storm and slay its core. After—or even during—your encounters with the Wither Storm, you must confront the Wither, harvest its Nether Stars, and fabricate your entry into the End, where you will face the final challenge—one not to be underestimated.

Custom advancements have been created to guide the player through the pack’s progression and to offer unique, grindy challenges for completionists.

Custom KubeJS scripts and datapacks have been developed to provide a fair and mostly seamless experience. Please note that some recipes have been altered, edited, or removed — JEI is your best friend.

And yes, the End has been locked behind the Wither and Wither Storm.

---
### Third Party Assets:
**Contains assets which are not included due to licence restraints but are recommended for the intended experience.**
